description: The pie chart represents the distribution of time costs between two categories. There are 2 slices in the chart. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction" and colored orange, occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart. The smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment" and colored blue, occupies around 30.08%. The percentage labels are shown inside the slices. One slice is visually emphasized by being separated from the other, which is labeled "Efficient deployment" and colored blue. The chart does not include a legend. The slices appear to be ordered in descending size, with the larger slice being "Reduction".
